implemented_requirements.evidence: claw.py defines angle, angle_speed, dir and update_swing() that oscillates between min_angle and max_angle.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can launch the claw to grab objects
implemented_requirements.evidence: claw.py provides launch(), extend(), and collision detection with objects in update().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Objects have a value and reel time
implemented_requirements.evidence: settings.py defines OBJECT_TYPES with value and reel_time; Gold, Rock, Diamond, Bone, TNT, MysteryBag pass these to GameObject constructor.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Level ends when time runs out or minimum gold value is met
implemented_requirements.evidence: Level class stores time_limit and target, but no code in game.py or elsewhere checks time_left or accumulated score to end the level.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display the position of the claw and objects, updating after each grab
implemented_requirements.evidence: No draw method for Claw is present; game.py’s draw() is not shown; objects rely on GameObject.draw() which is undefined in the provided files.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ascending difficulty with more obstacles or tighter time limits
implemented_requirements.evidence: level.py increases object counts, adds diamonds, TNT, mystery bags, and reduces time_limit and raises swing_speed per level.

critical_issues: Missing definition of the base class GameObject (imported but not provided), causing import errors.
game.py references methods handle_events(), update(), draw() that are not defined in the snippet, so the main loop cannot function.
No rendering code for the claw or for the objects; without a draw() implementation the positions are never displayed.
No logic that checks time_left or accumulated gold against the level target to transition to LEVEL_COMPLETE or GAME_OVER.
Input handling for launching the claw (e.g., mouse click or key press) is absent, so the player cannot actually time a grab.
judge.summary: The repository contains substantial parts of a Gold Miner clone—claw mechanics, level generation, object specifications, and a HUD—but critical components are missing. The core GameObject class, the main game loop's update/draw logic, rendering of the claw and objects, and the win/lose condition checks are absent. Consequently the program would not run and does not fully satisfy the benchmark requirements.
